notes.title: XANDO Official Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are excited to announce that XANDO:Xtreme & Over the Top is now officially out of Early Access and fully released! As stated previously, the price of the game has increased to $3.99 for those who have not yet purchased it. Between the Early Access version and this version, various bug fixes and minor improvements to the UI have been made. With the full release version, players also now have access to:

A story mode for each of the 4 starting characters
An unlockable character with their own deck
23 Achievements

Thank you to everyone who has supported us through this journey and helped bring our game to life. We appreciate you greatly! Now get out there, play some XANDO, and have fun!

notes.title: v0.03.12 Release
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40945138/348605d2c7f9a3bb0263883f2d25b050ab0eef18.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40945138/a5d36a1f25695c428df64edf8589fc3d38dc2365.jpg[/img][/url]Hi everyone! Today we are releasing version v0.03.12 of XANDO. Update notes are below. There are not as many changes in this version because we are hard at work getting the final version ready. On that note, we are happy to announce that we are planning the full release of XANDO to occur next month! We don’t have an exact date in mind but will let you all know when we do. Happy playing!

AI
A bug that caused the AI to not make moves at the start of a game has been fixed.
A bug that would sometimes crash Normal Tic-Tac-Toe has been fixed.
Difficulty for Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe has been added
Difficulty adjustments have been made for the XANDO AI

Other
Difficulty is now selected in Character Select instead of Seck Select
You may now change difficulty in the end game screen after a match is over.
Various bugs in the tutorial have been fixed.

notes.title: v0.03.07 release
notes.notes:
Hello all! We are happy to release v0.03.07 of XANDO. The vast majority of our work over this past month has been improving the XANDO AI and adding difficulty levels to it. So please check that out again and let us know what you think about the new difficulty levels! See below for a list of all of the updates. 

[u]XANDO AI[/u]
Various bug fixes and improvement to overall intelligence
Human players can no longer select the what space will be shielded/trapped for the AI
Human players can no longer select “Undo” for the AI
Added a difficulty select when facing the AI

[u]Art[/u]
Various tweaks and improvements to UI placement and size

[u]Music[/u]
Added in defeat music for when playing online or against an AI
When matches are getting closer to ending, the main theme now transitions to a “heat-up” track
